THEN.definition: Subsequently or soon afterward (often used as sentence connectors).

HATE.definition: The emotion of intense dislike; a feeling of dislike so strong that it demands action.

HEAT.gloss: a form of energy that is transferred by a difference in temperature
HEAT.definition: A form of energy that is transferred by a difference in temperature.

ANTE.gloss: the initial contribution that each player makes to the pot
ANTE.definition: (poker) the initial contribution that each player makes to the pot.

TEN.gloss: the cardinal number that is the sum of nine and one
TEN.definition: The cardinal number that is the sum of nine and one; the base of the decimal system.

NET.gloss: a computer network consisting of a worldwide network of computer networks that use the…
NET.definition: A computer network consisting of a worldwide network of computer networks that use the TCP/IP network protocols to facilitate data transmission and exchange.

TEA.gloss: a beverage made by steeping tea leaves in water
TEA.definition: A beverage made by steeping tea leaves in water.
TEA.example: Iced tea is a cooling drink.

HAT.gloss: headdress that protects the head from bad weather
HAT.definition: Headdress that protects the head from bad weather; has shaped crown and usually a brim.

TAN.gloss: a browning of the skin resulting from exposure to the rays of the sun
TAN.definition: A browning of the skin resulting from exposure to the rays of the sun.

ANT.gloss: social insect living in organized colonies
ANT.definition: Social insect living in organized colonies; characteristically the males and fertile queen have wings during breeding season; wingless sterile females are the workers.
